name: Betabound (by Centercode)

sources.title: Betabound signup — creates a TESTER account (Google OAuth or email); powered by Centercode; this is the tester side, not a product submission
Centercode homepage — the underlying beta-testing platform; 'Start for free, scale as your program grows'

conditions: There is no 'submit your product to Betabound' form — exposure to Betabound's tester community happens by running a beta test through Centercode, the platform that powers it
Centercode offers a free start tier (signup.centercode.com) but meaningful tester recruitment and scale are paid/managed services
You need a genuinely testable pre-release product and capacity to run a structured test
requirements: A real product ready for external user testing (beta/field test)
A Centercode account (free tier exists at signup.centercode.com; paid plans scale)
Betabound tester accounts are for TESTERS only — creating one does not list a product
Structured test: plan, recruitment criteria, feedback collection
preparation: Test plan: goals, target tester profile, duration
Centercode account (start free) or budget for managed testing services
workflow: Do NOT sign up at betabound.com/signup to promote — that creates a tester account
Instead start a Centercode account at signup.centercode.com or schedule a demo
Build the test project (plan, recruit criteria, activities)
Recruit testers — Centercode's tester community is the Betabound audience
Run the test; the 'listing' is ephemeral — testers see your product inside their test portal
watchFor: Category confusion: Betabound is a tester community, not a launch directory — no public product listing or backlink results
Real work required: running a beta test is a program, not a submission
Managed services/recruitment are the paid levers Centercode sells
Value is feedback and beta users, not SEO
countsAsLive: Your beta test is live inside Centercode/Betabound with testers applying to participate — there is no public listing page
unknowns: Centercode pricing tiers beyond the free start
How much Betabound community exposure a free-tier project actually gets
Whether tests can recruit purely from Betabound or require your own testers
